name: 35759 · Meridianville, AL
findings: ZIP 35759 (Meridianville) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 35759 (Meridianville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 35759 (Meridianville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.
